d:
Got a wild animal problem? Turtleman might be just the person to call! Ernie Brown Jr. is taking on one wildlife rescue mission after another, stepping into unpredictable situations where animals need to be caught, relocated or safely removed.
Alongside his team, including Neal James, Turtleman brings his unique animal catching skills and larger than life personality to every rescue. From surprising encounters to challenging captures, these moments from Call of the Wildman show why no two calls for help are ever quite the same.
